channel.title: Yash Agarwal
channel.description: MS student in Intelligent Information Systems at Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science, working on machine learning systems.

item.title: Skipping attention blocks was the easy part
item.description: BLASST block-sparse attention plus one TMEM address swap: −41.9% attention-kernel time at 95% skip and −20% TTFT at 64K with accuracy above dense — an optimization worklog on a B200.

item.title: DSpark on MAX: making speculative decoding beat vLLM
item.description: How speculative decoding for Gemma4 on Modular's MAX went from 30% behind vLLM under load to outside its latency/throughput curve on every dataset at concurrency 8 and 64, on one B200.

item.title: How I beat NVIDIA at allocating pinned host memory
item.description: 9× faster than cuMemAllocHost, and faster than CUDA's own VMM API too — an optimization worklog on an 8×B200 host.
